author: TheTruthSleuth
quote: Game thus far has been okay. However it needs to be pointed out that in a game based on the British Intelligence literally 90% of the main characters are a person of colour. It is just stupid how you’re walking around MI6 and Bond is one of very few white people. It’s so bad it doesn’t make any logical sense. It sadly echoes the times we are living in.

author: TheTruthSleuth
quote: It feels like a quick win for Nintendo with Mario Kart World in theory they are allowing u to free roam maps without the need to race but instead "explore" but seriously guys maybe 5% of your fanbase probably care about that. In my opinion they could have skipped this title completely and just given Mario Kart 8 Deluxe an Upgrade Pack then called it a day and we'd be equally pleased. This by far has been the worst launch I've been witness to and if a Nintendo rep asked if I'd like a full refund for the whole system and games (including Donkey Kong Bananza) I'd snap up that offer in a heartbeat. Nintendo seem really lost at the moment with who they are and where they are headed. I would say the next big test for them is Metroid Prime and if they get that wrong it's gonna be really telling foe the future of Nintendo.

author: TheTruthSleuth
quote: They say the art of originality is to hide your original source , that statement pretty much sums up this game. It's copying so many other games that it struggles in my view to be original and it hinges entirely on the destruction mechanic and lacks any real good platforming or gameplay. The cut scenes are okay but for what Nintendo is asking for this game in terms of money is ridiculous. The 10/10 reviews have to be completely bias , this game gets very old very quickly due to its derivative nature and bad camera angles. It felt like the Temu Astrobot
